## Purpose
Create, read, update and delete Mistral agents (Agents API). It also handles connector attachments, guardrail configuration, optional rules and knowledge-graph opt-in; listing can be sorted across every page.

## Responsibilities
- **`GET /agents?page=0&page_size=20&sort=`:**
  - without a valid `sort` it returns the single page `agent_service.list_agents(page, page_size)`;
  - with `sort` in `newest`, `oldest`, `name_asc` or `name_desc` it reads every page (up to 20 pages of 100, so at most 2,000 agents), sorts by `created_at` or by lower-cased name, and returns a slice with `{items, page, page_size, total_pages, count}`.
- **`GET /agents/{id}`** returns `agent_service.get_agent`.
- **`POST /agents`** takes `CreateAgentRequest`:
  - `name`, `model` (default `DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL`), `instructions` (default "You are a helpful assistant."), `description`, `tier`, `tools=[]`;
  - `document_library_ids` and `connectors[ConnectorRef{connector_id, include, exclude, requires_confirmation}]`;
  - completion arguments: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, random_seed, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty;
  - `knowledge_graph=False`;
  - `guardrails[GuardrailConfigRequest{block_on_error, moderation_llm_v1|v2{model_name, custom_category_thresholds, ignore_other_categories, action}}]`;
  - `rules[AgentRuleRef{rule_id, source ai|user, reason}]`.
  It returns `agent_service.create_agent(client, body)`.
- **`PATCH /agents/{id}`** takes `UpdateAgentRequest`, dumped with `exclude_none`:
  - an omitted field leaves the value as it is;
  - an empty `connectors` list detaches every connector;
  - `knowledge_graph=False` detaches the knowledge tool;
  - an empty `guardrails` list clears them.
- **`DELETE /agents/{id}`** deletes only the agent. Its tools, libraries and connectors are detached, not deleted. It removes the agent's graph annotations (`delete_rules.forget_in_graph("agent", id)`) and invalidates the `rag.scope` cache entry.

## Key elements
`GuardrailCategoryThresholdsRequest` holds the union of the v1 and v2 categories, each 0–1. This mirrors `core/specs.V1_CATEGORIES` and `V2_CATEGORIES`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
- Calls Mistral.
- Annotation, rule and ontology writes happen inside `agent_service`.

## Configuration
`DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL`.

## Interactions
- Route policy: agents.view for GET and agents.manage for writes.
- Used by the frontend Agents pages.

## Error handling and edge cases
`AgentNotFoundError` and `MistralAPIError` from the service go through the global handlers.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Sorting reads every page**, because sorting a single page would not make page 2 continue page 1.
- **The guardrails list allows several entries**, mirroring Mistral's API, but at most one is used in practice.

## How to rebuild this file
The pydantic models and five handlers described above.

## Tests
`backend/tests/test_delete_rules.py` and `test_builder_agent_evaluation.py`. Route behaviour is mostly untested.
